outcome: incidence rate of placenta accreta spectrum
cohort: The study included 184,415 patients with a history of low transverse cesarean delivery who achieved a vaginal delivery in the current index hospital admission.
finding: The incidence of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) at vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC) was 8.1 per 10,000 deliveries, and its diagnosis was associated with significant maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: The study specifically investigates placenta accreta spectrum and its associated morbidities when diagnosed during a vaginal birth after a previous cesarean delivery.
